comments.snippet: The error occurred when I closed an active connection tab within a panel in mRemoteNG while using an MSSQL database as the configuration source.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet: Thanks for the report and the extra context. What happened here: when a task dialog opens (e.g. the disconnect confirmation when you close an active tab), mRemoteNG plays the matching system sound via `System.Media.SystemSounds`. That type lives in `System.Windows.Extensions.dll`, which is part of the **.NET Windows Desktop runtime** — it isn't inside the portable ZIP, it's resolved from the runtime installed on the machine. On your install that assembly couldn't be resolved, which is why the di...

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Closing as fixed in **v1.83.0**, on our own verification.

**Why we're closing it ourselves:** the broken managed preflight that produced this crash was deleted outright, and the release pipeline now verifies the shipped assembly layout (71/71 assemblies) plus an app-start smoke test on every build — the exact failure mode here (a missing assembly only visible at startup on a clean machine) is now exercised by CI itself, which is precisely what the unit tests could not see when this was reported...
